title: Published discovery document
description: Contract for v1/meta.json, the entry point a consumer reads first: what this dataset is, which release it is, where the schemas live, what every endpoint is called, and the licensing split. Pinning it matters more than its size suggests - `endpoints` and `vocab` are the machine-readable index of the whole API, and `text_rights` is the licence carve-out that keeps © Scouting America requirement text distinct from the CC-licensed remainder. Fields are ADDITIVE-ONLY under v1.

version.description: The release this tree was built from; '+unreleased' marks a build ahead of the newest CHANGELOG entry.

license.description: Covers the dataset EXCEPT the official requirement text described by `text_rights`.

unofficial.description: Always true, and deliberately not optional: this is a community project with no Scouting America affiliation, and a consumer must not be able to lose that by reading a subset of the document.

datasets.description: Per-dataset counts. `total` spans every entity including historical ones; `current` counts those with an open version. Extra per-dataset keys (e.g. camps' `merged`) may appear.
